QatarEnergy and ExxonMobil will independently offtake and market their respective proportionate equity shares of LNG produced by the Golden Pass project. Even as liquefied natural gas (LNG) is seen as a key transitionary fuel for bunkering, soaring prices of the super-chilled fuel have led to higher demand for ships with dual-fuel tankers, said an industry executive. Profit doubled year/year but fell quarter/quarter. Jadestone had in 2019 signed a deal with Austria's OMV to buy an operated 69% interest in the Maari project, offshore New Zealand. Energy firm Equinor will supply Norwegian gas to Denmark's Orsted via the newly opened Baltic Pipe equivalent to about a quarter of expected total Danish gas consumption, Orsted said on Thursday. Japan's biggest city gas supplier Tokyo Gas Co Ltd does not expect its procurement of liquefied natural gas to be heavily affected by recent disruptions to Malaysia LNG supplies due to a pipeline leak, its finance chief said on Thursday. Norway, now Europe's biggest supplier of natural gas, has increased its pipeline inspections in the wake of the suspected blasts on the Nord Stream system last month, the head of the country's gas supply infrastructure told Reuters. German Chancellor Olaf Scholz said on Thursday that EU energy ministers still have much work to do but a solution could be found to contain speculative spikes in gas prices. The Chinese state-owned company made five discoveries during the quarter. Russia's invasion of Ukraine has driven a stake into global natural gas markets. Earnings include a third impairment related to Russia. Europe slashed its gas use in August and September as industries cut production in response to soaring prices and scarce Russian supply, although the cuts were unevenly spread between countries. 天气与需求.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.

historical_events.title: Gas market at an unstable equilibrium, waiting for supply hints Africa’s Golden Age of Natural Gas is Upon Us Russia’s new O&G discoveries drop to five-year low “Energy for All” is achievable with natural gas Woodside moves forward with Tasmania hydrogen project US upstream Lower 48 M&A deals on the rise as operators continue to consolidate and build upon core assets Botala Energy, Pure Hydrogen spud CBM well in Botswana Aker wins umbilicals contract for Jansz-Io compression project Neptune sheds non-core Norwegian assets Invictus reports "encouraging" seismic results in Zimbabwe Air Liquide, Schneider sign climate memo with Russian steel producer TTF climbs further on Nov 12 Beyond Oil initiative fails to secure major producers as members Diversified divests Texas acreage Henry Hub slips below $5/mn Btu Norway’s Lime Petroleum mulls offshore CCS Kremlin distances itself from Belarusian threat to halt gas transit US sees natural gas demand growing Africa still needs fossil fuels: press Far East gas pipeline expansion nearly complete
historical_events.summary: This week gas prices are at an unstable equilibrium, with traders waiting for further supply hints and watching Russia-Europe flows with bated breath. In recent years, natural gas has offered some of the most exciting developments and commercial discoveries, Energy Capital & Power says. Russia has seen the number of new oil and gas discoveries drop to a five-year low, according to GlobalData. Gas is the cleanest of all fossil fuels, and its abundance, flexibility, and affordability makes it an ideal fuel of choice, according to the GECF. The company has secured land for its proposed H2TAS hydrogen plant. There has been an increase in the number of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) made in the US Lower 48 upstream sector in 2021. Serowe 4 well is the first of a two-well programme to be completed before the end of 2021. The $4bn Jansz-Io Compression project represents Chevron’s most significant capital investment in Australia since the sanctioning of the Gorgon stage 2 project in 2018. The company is honing its focus on its core Gjoa, Gudrun, Njord, Dugong and Snohvit fields. The Cabora Bassa 2021 seismic survey was completed earlier this month with a total of 839.5 km of high-resolution 2D seismic data acquired. Severstal is working with other companies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions across its supply chain. Analysts believe Lukashenko's threat to halt Russian gas transit via Belarus is hollow. The core members have pledged to set an end date for oil and gas exploration and production in line with Paris goals, and commit to ending drilling licensing. The buyer was not identified. The December contract is on pace for a decline of more than 5% on the week. The Norwegian government has said there is a huge potential to sequester carbon on its continental shelf. Analysts view the threat as hollow. Storage levels are close to normal, but winter weather could change that. Several developing nations on the African continent say they need the revenue for future investments. Russia’s Gazprom said it expects to finish work on the SKV pipeline by the end of the year.
